title: 欢迎页
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE fully legible, high fidelity desktop web interface, 1536×1024 landscape. This is a formal design target for the existing Social Theory Library 社会理论书库 website. Editorial precision, exceptionally finished typography and proportion. Paper-white #F7F4EE ground, pure white work surfaces, charcoal #25241F text, warm gray borders #D6D0C4, restrained sand gold #AD8245, no blue. Chinese headings in refined Noto Serif SC, UI and body in Noto Sans SC, readable 16-18px body, large headings only when editorially appropriate. Squared 3px corners, fine rules, almost no shadow. Calm, exact alignment, dense enough for actual work, generous readable text. Existing black and sand-gold book-page/person emblem at appropriate size, bilingual names Social Theory Library and 社会理论书库; no STL letters, no AI icon. Production implementation will use the exact existing SVG emblem, never the generated mark. All invented material must visibly say 示例数据. Neutral synthetic book titles and people, never fabricate a real scholar's quote/page/publication. No extra functionality, no decorative statistics, no ratings, no invented chat assistant, no Intelligence, no Elicit. No browser chrome, no perspective mockup, no big presentation title, no multi-screen collage. The entire image is one real page at usable reading size.
Critical refinement: flat SOLID fills only, no gradients, paper texture or metallic texture anywhere. No artificial drop shadows. Use gold only for selection markers and occasional restrained active state; primary commands are solid charcoal. No giant headers for task pages. A 180–210px sidebar, 44–64px toolbar and balanced readable main areas. Preserve every named real operation. Show synthetic content as 示例数据, but do not crowd every navigation label with it. Do not draw any count, percentage, date or academic quotation as a real fact. Only show numbers needed for UI controls, or explicitly synthetic. The image is one coherent page, never a contact sheet.
Formal design P01, 欢迎页. Specific verified workflow: 大幅但克制的双语品牌与介绍；左主文案/进入书库，右同画面的连续功能演示。原文优先/问题出发/思想交锋三版随机但同次不轮换。下方学者、理论、主题、策划与连续研究，暂停/重播、减少动效。只画当前示例演示帧，无真实检索。
Use page-appropriate navigation: public pages horizontal compact bilingual brand; private reader pages a compact sidebar plus return to library; administration pages compact centered brand/sidebar and clear object breadcrumb. Focus the layout on this workflow. Display relevant list, selection, fields and authentic page preview at legible size. Do not invent features to fill space. This design maps to PV119, PV151 in the deployment inventory.
